tool_args.rationale: The prior attempt failed because its prediction function referenced an unset global parameter vector. This version defines and populates that vector in fit(), numerically fits the four coupled-ODE parameters, and then predicts x(H) using RK4 at dt no greater than 0.004. The eight paid rows support proceeding to fresh confirmation without further measurement.

considered_alternatives.rejected_reason: All observations have H=0.6 and the recurrent evidence identifies a coupled transient mechanism; the available eight rows are enough to fit its four parameters, so a longer-horizon probe is not required before confirmation.
The supplied verified mechanism matches the observed history-gap and transient-lag signatures; there is no evidence requiring a branch alternative.
